summary: Vanillaware's side-scrolling real-time strategy game, later expanded as GrimGrimoire OnceMore.

entries.title: GrimGrimoire

emulation.emulator: None for primary; PCSX2 for PS2 original

primary.why: OnceMore is an expanded remaster with enhanced graphics, gameplay additions, mid-battle saves, fast-forward, and other quality-of-life changes; PS5 is the highest-fidelity shipped platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play GrimGrimoire OnceMore on PS5. PS4 and Switch are valid alternatives; use PS2 only for original-version comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for fidelity and features by the OnceMore remaster.
skip: complete modern route, but lower capture/fidelity ceiling than PS5.
skip: complete modern route, but PS5 is the best shipped console target.
primary: definitive expanded remaster on the strongest shipped platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: OnceMore is both the enhanced and more complete route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC release is documented; pick PS5 for the archive run.
